vibe_rationale: Free month-long grassroots skate festival with comps, DJs and food in the south-east suburbs, not a curated culture moment.
fit_notes: Family and youth-skewed suburban crowd with little health relevance, and skating was cancelled for 2026 on safety advice, so the event's status is unclear.
